evidence.claim: ChatCompressionService uses a Reverse Token Budget of 50,000 tokens for function responses, truncating older large tool responses to 30 lines.
ChatCompressionService.compress receives a GeminiChat instance and calls chat.getHistory(true) directly; it is a structural exception to the spec's blanket 'don't touch GeminiChat directly' rule.
ChatCompressionService performs a Probe verification step after generating a summary to ensure no critical constraints or details were lost.
ContextCompressionService batches file read outputs to an LLM to decide routing levels (FULL, PARTIAL, SUMMARY, EXCLUDED) and caches decisions.
ToolOutputMaskingService protects the newest 50,000 tool tokens and optionally the entire latest turn from being masked.
ToolOutputDistillationService exempts read_file and read_many_files from distillation.
MemoryService runs a background SkillExtractionAgent on sessions that have been idle for at least 3 hours and have at least 10 user messages.
MemoryContextManager performs Just-In-Time memory discovery by traversing upwards from an accessed path to find GEMINI.md files.
SessionSummaryService uses Gemini Flash-Lite with a sliding window of first-N + last-N messages (default MAX_MESSAGES=20, TIMEOUT=5s) to produce a 1-line session summary.

contradictions.description: Pollux spec §14 'Don't touch GeminiChat directly' is too absolute. ChatCompressionService.compress is signed compress(chat: GeminiChat, ...) and already reads history via chat.getHistory(true); any Pollux advisor-context trimming path that overlaps this service has precedent for direct GeminiChat access. Maps to forensic F-09.

risks.description: Over-truncation. AgentHistoryProvider might break functionCall/functionResponse pairs if the truncation boundary falls between them.
risks.suggestedGuard: ensure adjustBoundaryForIntegrity handles all edge cases

risks.description: Stale summaries. ChatCompressionService might lose critical constraints in summaries if the Probe verification fails to catch omissions.
Lost tool evidence. ToolOutputMaskingService masks older tool outputs, which might remove necessary context for long-running tasks.
risks.suggestedGuard: ensure users can easily retrieve masked outputs

risks.description: Memory drift. MemoryService background skill extraction might duplicate existing skills or extract low-quality skills.
risks.suggestedGuard: refine SkillExtractionAgent prompts and rely on buildExistingSkillsSummary

risks.description: Pollux advisor-context trimming (spec §12 Risk 3) could collide with ChatCompressionService.compress if both mutate history around the same turn.
risks.suggestedGuard: serialize Pollux trim + compression on a per-turn lock held inside ChatCompressionService

gaps: OQ-08.1 — handling of extremely large files in context compression routing.
R-08.5 — no test asserts Pollux trim + compression non-interference.

openQuestions: OQ-08.1: How does the context compression routing model (chat-compression-2.5-flash-lite) handle extremely large files that exceed its own context window? Escalate to compartment 14.
